name: Diffusion Direction Count
description: Validates the number of unique diffusion gradient directions, excluding b=0 volumes. Configure a minimum (error below), an optional recommended count (warning below), or an exact required count.

testCases.name: 3 directions fail when minimum raised to 30

parameterDefinitions.name: min_directions
parameterDefinitions.label: Minimum directions
parameterDefinitions.description: Fail if fewer unique directions than this

parameterDefinitions.name: recommended_directions
parameterDefinitions.label: Recommended directions
parameterDefinitions.description: Warn if fewer unique directions than this (optional)

parameterDefinitions.name: exact_directions
parameterDefinitions.label: Exact directions
parameterDefinitions.description: Require exactly this many directions (overrides min/recommended)

parameterDefinitions.name: b0_threshold
parameterDefinitions.label: b=0 threshold
parameterDefinitions.description: Volumes with b-value at or below this are excluded (b=0 orientations are meaningless)
